groups.label: Model assumptions
groups.description: Behavioral sensitivity assumptions used by the demand model.

groups.label: Fuel levers
groups.description: Fuel and electricity tax assumptions applied to product prices.

elasticity_set.label: Elasticities
elasticity_set.description: Price-response assumptions used by the demand model.

conservative_fridstrom.label: Fridström
conservative_fridstrom.description: Fridström and Østli purchase-price and energy-price elasticities.

central_xing_vesterberg.label: Xing + Vesterberg
central_xing_vesterberg.description: Xing purchase-price elasticities with Vesterberg's main Swedish BEV electricity-price response.

high_response.label: High response
high_response.description: Xing purchase-price elasticities with Vesterberg's high Swedish BEV electricity-price response.

technology_scenario.label: Technology path
technology_scenario.description: BEV diffusion path from vehicle technology, model availability, charging infrastructure, and EU vehicle regulation.

conservative_technology.label: Conservative
conservative_technology.description: Slower technology and infrastructure path with lower BEV diffusion.

central_technology.label: Central
central_technology.description: Main technology, model availability, infrastructure, and regulation path.

accelerated_technology.label: Accelerated
accelerated_technology.description: Faster technology and model availability path with higher BEV diffusion.

purchase_price_policy.label: Klimatbonus
purchase_price_policy.description: BEV and PHEV purchase support from 2027 onward, in real 2024 SEK. Support levels are differentiated by drivetrain.

adopted.label: Adopted
adopted.description: No broad reintroduced BEV/PHEV purchase support.

low_indexed.label: Low indexed
low_indexed.description: Half of the approximate 2023 BEV and PHEV support levels, kept constant in real 2024 SEK.

legacy_indexed.label: Legacy indexed
legacy_indexed.description: Approximate 2023 BEV and PHEV support levels, kept constant in real 2024 SEK.

high_indexed.label: High indexed
high_indexed.description: 150 percent of the approximate 2023 BEV and PHEV support levels, kept constant in real 2024 SEK.

adopted.label: Adopted
adopted.description: Adopted gasoline and diesel excise-tax levels.

plus30.description: Gasoline and diesel excise taxes 30 percent above adopted levels.

tax_indexation.label: CPI indexation
tax_indexation.description: How gasoline and diesel excise taxes are updated after 2025.

adopted.label: Adopted
adopted.description: The adopted path keeps 2025 tax rates fixed in nominal terms through the forecast.

cpi_indexed.label: CPI indexed
cpi_indexed.description: Annual CPI adjustment, keeping the tax level constant in real terms. This mirrors the standard Swedish indexation logic for fuel excise taxes.

gdp_indexation.label: GDP indexation
gdp_indexation.description: GDP-linked fuel-tax indexation for gasoline and diesel.

off.label: Adopted
off.description: Current adopted path without the earlier GDP indexation rule.

on.label: GDP indexed
on.description: Adds the earlier Swedish over-indexation rule, approximated here as 1.6 percent per year in real terms.

electricity_tax.label: Electricity tax
electricity_tax.description: Electricity excise tax and VAT applied to the home consumer charging price.

adopted.label: Adopted
adopted.description: 36.0 öre/kWh electricity tax with 25 percent VAT.

north_reduction.label: North reduction
north_reduction.description: 26.4 öre/kWh electricity tax with 25 percent VAT, matching the reduced Swedish electricity-tax area.

industrial.label: Industrial
industrial.description: 0.6 öre/kWh electricity tax with 25 percent VAT, approximating the tax level for industrial electricity use.

vat_reduced.label: VAT reduced
vat_reduced.description: 0.6 öre/kWh electricity tax with 12 percent VAT, adding a lower consumer VAT assumption to the industrial-rate electricity tax.

ets2.label: ETS2
ets2.description: EU carbon price for road-fuel emissions.

adopted.label: Adopted
adopted.description: Commission-aligned path: about EUR 60/tCO2 in 2030, starting near the ETS2 price-stability level and rising gradually after 2030.

high_market.label: High market
high_market.description: Higher market-price path: around EUR 122/tCO2 in 2030, based on BloombergNEF's ETS2 projection, then rising gradually to 2035.

sources.label: European Commission Social Climate Plan guidance
